components.title: Process validation and evaluation
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Description, documentation, and results of validation/evaluation studies for critical steps or critical assays. CONTRACT: Summary narrative; reference batch numbers and conclusions from source.

components.title: Validation study summary
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Tabulated validation batches/studies when present. Columns: Study/step, Batches, Result/conclusion.
